items.title: Ernest Roubleau Interview, 1961-10-18
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] Is there anything about Prince that you can tell us anything about his style? ... [INTERVIEWEE] High register. Just any way you want it.

ctx.x: I played up some banjo at that time.
Is there anything about Prince that you can tell us anything about his style? Did he get around real fast, or a big tone, or high notes? Low register. What did he do? Low register. Low register.
High register. Just any way you want it.
